official_identity_sources.observation: Official Baxter product page identifies Casablanca by Paola Navone and currently lists the 180 x 200 cm bed-base version as 210 x 252 x 90 cm overall.

Official technical sheet visually identifies the 180 x 200 cm slatted-base version as 220 x 252 x 90 cm overall. Its dimension diagrams are identity and dimension evidence only, not native CAD geometry.

official_product_cad.reason: The official product page requires login for 2D, 3D and BIM downloads. No account was created and no third-party or visually similar Casablanca CAD was substituted.

dimension_cross_check.note: The current official product page and the archived official technical sheet disagree by 100 mm in overall width for the 180 x 200 cm bed-base version. The detailed IFC Body is closer to the technical sheet but does not exactly match either source. The conflict is retained and no geometry is anisotropically fitted.
